'''K4-06B''', also known as '''"Kay,"''' was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] [[Secretary droid/Legends|secretary droid]] who was partnered with [[Uurk]], a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Police officer/Legends|lawkeeper]] of the [[Emmer police]]. He was specialized in translating Uurk's [[Gamorrese]], defusing bombs, dealing with kidnappers and terrorists, and doing paperwork.<ref name="Elusive" />
